reviewer: Claude source, predicate and witness review
scope: robocasa OpenDrawer at the pinned revision; seed 0 witness only. Semantic projection of the official predicate, not physical qualification of other seeds or scenes.
task_language: Open the left drawer. (The side word is sampled per scene: left or right.)

predicate_and_helpers.basis: Read ManipulateDrawer._check_success, Drawer.get_door_state/set_door_state and OU.normalize_joint_value; the only condition is the slide fraction of the one target drawer.

reset_and_randomization.basis: Read _setup_kitchen_references/_place_robot/_get_obj_cfgs: target drawer, side word and robot placement are sampled per seed; all drawers start closed; a tool/utensil object sits inside and one to three distractors sit on the counter.

assets_and_frames.basis: The slide joint sign is negative outward; door_state uses 0.55 x size[1] as full scale, so door_state can exceed one when the drawer is pulled further.

success_timing.basis: Kitchen._check_success is evaluated after every control step; the ORA session latches the first success and ends the episode.

public_observability.basis: Drawer opening is visible in the base-mounted agentview and wrist cameras; no private state is needed to judge it.

success_witness.basis: Witness record: the predicate's own set_door_state at 1.0 and 0.96 gives check_success true on seed 0.

counterexamples.basis: Witness: 0.9 and 0.5 give false; reset state false.

no_expert_strategy.basis: Clauses state end conditions only; no approach, grasp, route or motion advice.

privacy.basis: No coordinates, thresholds, fixture or object identifiers, joint values or predicate names enter the public text; numeric limits stay in this private record.

conditions.source_basis: ManipulateDrawer._check_success: every door_state value >= 0.95; Drawer.get_door_state normalizes the slide joint by 0.55 of the drawer depth (size[1]), so the bar is a slide of about 0.52 of the depth.
conditions.interpretation: The drawer must be pulled out to about half its depth or more.

conditions.source_basis: ManipulateDrawer.get_ep_meta: the drawer side word in the language names which drawer; robot is placed beside that drawer.
conditions.interpretation: Open the drawer the instruction names.
Exact normalized fraction (0.95 of 0.55 depth) withheld.
conditions.omission_reason: Numeric limit stays qualitative in public text; the object inside the drawer is irrelevant to the predicate.

public_clauses: Pull the named drawer out until roughly half of its depth or more is exposed; a drawer opened only a little does not complete the task.

counterexamples.case: Drawer pulled out to 0.9 of the predicate's normalized opening (about 0.50 of the depth): check_success false.
Drawer at half the predicate's normalized opening: check_success false.

limitations: Witness covers seed 0 only and uses direct state edits or scripted moves, never a policy rollout; source-derived negative cases marked as such were not executed.
